hypotheses.T1_correct_tangent_beats_wrong_target: Correct-tangent top-16 selection exceeds unrelated-target top-16 selection by at least 0.05 aggregate Fisher fidelity.
hypotheses.T2_correct_tangent_beats_shuffled_pair_d: Correct-tangent top-16 selection exceeds a shuffled lexical-pair tangent by at least 0.05 aggregate fidelity.
hypotheses.T3_correct_tangent_beats_generic_random_: Correct-tangent top-16 selection exceeds a four-probe random-JVP susceptibility map by at least 0.05 aggregate fidelity.
hypotheses.T4_program_support_is_target_specific: Correct and wrong-target top-16 selections have median Jaccard overlap at most 0.75.
hypotheses.T5_generic_jacobian_susceptibility_beats: Random-JVP susceptibility top-16 exceeds base-source-magnitude top-16 by at least 0.05.
hypotheses.T6_correct_jvp_support_remains_robust: Correct-JVP top-32 has at least 0.90 aggregate and 0.75 fifth-percentile individual fidelity in the recreated panel.
hypotheses.T7_selection_is_much_better_than_linear_: Correct-JVP top-32 selection exceeds all-source JVP reconstruction by at least 0.25 fidelity.
hypotheses.T8_norm_selection_is_sign_blind: Negating the input tangent leaves every JVP norm ranking exactly unchanged.
hypotheses.T9_wrong_tangents_do_not_define_semantic: The cosine of correct- and wrong-target predicted source tensors is below 0.80 median even if their selected supports overlap.
hypotheses.T10_support_is_instead_a_generic_context: Wrong-target top-16 is within 0.02 of correct-target fidelity and their median top-16 Jaccard is at least 0.70.
